items.b: EGYPT'S GOLD EXPORTS FALL 44% WITH UAE SHIPMENTS DOWN 65%
items.t: January to July shipments reached about $2.4bn against $4.3bn. The Emirates took about $1.2bn against $3.4bn, and the Federation of Egyptian Industries blames war-disrupted air freight rather than Emirati buying.

items.b: INDIA'S POLISHED CARAT FETCHES $671.39, ITS GROWN CARAT $66.51
items.t: GJEPC's April-to-August master report puts natural polished value 7.38% lower on 6.75% more carats. Grown polished shipped 80.24 lakh carats against natural's 67.34 lakh, at about a tenth of the price.

items.b: DIAMOND WORKERS' UNION GUJARAT ASKS GJEPC FOR A WAGE SURVEY
items.t: A letter dated 24 September asks the council and the Commerce Ministry to survey piece rates across Gujarat. Two Gujarati reports add a union count of about 100 cutter suicides in two years.
